author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 작은 무리가 드물게 찾아와 해안 앞바다나 하구에서 겨울을 나는 겨울철새이다. 월동지에서는 무리를 지어 바다에서 생활하며 잠수를 잘하고, 복족류, 갑각류, 물속 곤충, 수생 식물 등을 먹는다. 유라시아와 북아메리카의 북극해 연안에서 번식하는데, 툰드라 땅 위에 마른풀이나 관목 가지로 둥지를 짓고 알 6~8개를 낳는다.

art.subject: Long-tailed Duck (Clangula hyemalis), adult male in winter, as seen off Korean coasts from November to March: head and neck white, with a pale grey-buff face around the eye and a large blackish-brown patch on the side of the neck below and behind the cheek; breast black, forming a broad band; back black; long pale grey-white scapulars draped over the sides of the back; wings blackish-brown; flanks and belly white; two very long, thin black central tail feathers; bill short, black with a broad pink band across the outer half and a black nail; dark eye; legs grey.
art.pose: swimming on choppy sea water, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter coastal sea off a river mouth; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view swimming: white head and neck with a grey-buff face, large blackish-brown neck patch, black breast band and back, long pale grey scapulars, white flanks, very long thin black central tail feathers raised
adult male winter, head detail in profile: white head, grey-buff face around the dark eye, blackish-brown patch below and behind the cheek, short black bill with a broad pink band
art.build: Small, compact sea duck: the male about 57cm including the long tail streamers, its body smaller than a Mallard's; the female lacks the streamers and looks much smaller. Rounded head with a steep forehead, short neck, small stubby bill much shorter than the head. Legs short, grey, set far back. Swims buoyantly in rough sea and dives often. At rest the wingtips reach the tail base. In flight the wings are uniformly dark without any white patch, contrasting with the white belly.
avoid: Do not paint any white patch or bar on the wings; the wings are all dark.
Do not paint the long, slender neck and long bill of Northern Pintail (Anas acuta); this species is short-necked and stubby-billed.
Do not paint summer plumage (dark head and breast with a white face patch) on wintering birds in Korea.
Do not give the female long tail streamers.
